alt: 屋主用布遮住椅腳鬆動處，轉頭擺手拒絕朋友遞來的修補工具，旁邊另一把椅子已經歪倒、掉了一隻腳。
scene_prompt: In a modern home a chair has a small clearly loose wooden leg joint. A young adult who owns it hides the wobbling joint with a cloth and turns their head away with a dismissive raised palm. A concerned friend kneels nearby offering a small bottle of wood glue and pointing to the obvious loose joint. Behind the owner, another matching chair previously ignored has now slumped crookedly on the floor with a detached leg, showing the consequence of refusing an easy repair. No one sits on either chair; no injury or medical imagery. Make concealment, refusal and worsening small defect visible in one coherent scene, natural limbs.
